collections.title: The ArtCraft suite
collections.subtitle: 17 native creative and office apps, one launcher

apps.name: ArtCraft
apps.pitch: An IDE for artists: controllable AI image and video with 2D and 3D scene tools.
apps.why: The flagship of the ArtCraft project; local-first, permissive licence, native Rust app.

apps.name: Craft Launcher
apps.pitch: Installs and updates the whole ArtCraft suite (PhotoCraft, WordCraft, DeckCraft, GridCraft and more).
apps.why: One launcher for 17 open-source creative and office rewrites; Lens installs the launcher, the launcher manages the apps.
apps.notes: Some coverage mentions 'fair source' terms in parts of the wider ArtCraft project; check each app's repo licence before commercial redistribution.

apps.why: A new open-source take on Photoshop; installs through the Craft Launcher.
apps.notes: Early alpha / in development per getartcraft.com (November 2026).

apps.name: Concat
apps.pitch: Free, local-first video editor that replaces CapCut, with AI captions and an MCP/JSON-RPC API.
apps.why: 11.9k stars, fully local (Whisper captions on your PC), scriptable over MCP, so Lens AI can drive edits.

apps.name: degenview
apps.pitch: Open-source TradingView-style charting app in Rust with a local Pine Script v6 engine.
apps.why: A native desktop rewrite (no Electron) with Pine scripts, many data sources and a paper-trading simulator that never routes orders.
apps.notes: Windows builds are not code-signed yet, so SmartScreen may warn on first launch. Charting and paper trading only; Lens never connects it to a broker.

apps.name: OpenCharts
apps.pitch: Self-hosted TradingView alternative in the browser, built on Lightweight Charts.
apps.why: Runs entirely in the browser with drawing tools, indicators and a paper-trading engine; MIT licence.

apps.name: OpenStock
apps.pitch: Open-source market dashboard: prices, alerts and company insights.
apps.why: 16.3k stars; a free alternative to paid market platforms. Web app you can self-host.
apps.notes: The public demo asks you to sign up; self-hosting keeps your watchlists on your own server.

apps.name: AFFiNE
apps.pitch: Docs, whiteboards and databases in one local-first workspace.
apps.why: A Notion and Miro rewrite that works offline and keeps data on your PC.

apps.name: AppFlowy
apps.pitch: Open-source Notion alternative with docs, databases and local AI.
apps.why: Notion-style workspace with your data on your device.

apps.name: ONLYOFFICE Desktop Editors
apps.pitch: Documents, spreadsheets, slides and PDFs with strong Microsoft Office compatibility.
apps.why: The closest open-source match to Word, Excel and PowerPoint layouts.

apps.name: LibreOffice
apps.pitch: The full open-source office suite: Writer, Calc, Impress, Draw.
apps.why: Mature, free forever, opens nearly everything.

apps.name: Penpot
apps.pitch: Open-source design and prototyping, built on open web standards.
apps.why: Figma-style collaborative design that you can self-host.

apps.name: Krita
apps.pitch: Professional painting and illustration.
apps.why: The best free painting app on Windows.

apps.name: Inkscape
apps.pitch: Vector graphics editor for SVG.
apps.why: Mature, free Illustrator alternative.

apps.name: Blender
apps.pitch: 3D modelling, animation, rendering and video editing.
apps.why: The standard free 3D suite.

apps.name: Kdenlive
apps.pitch: Multi-track video editor.
apps.why: Long-standing, capable open-source editor.

apps.name: Shotcut
apps.pitch: Simple, fast video editor.
apps.why: Lightweight alternative for quick edits.

apps.name: OBS Studio
apps.pitch: Screen recording and live streaming.
apps.why: The standard for recording and streaming.

apps.name: Audacity
apps.pitch: Record and edit audio.
apps.why: Fast, familiar audio editing.

apps.name: darktable
apps.pitch: Photo workflow and RAW developer.
apps.why: A mature Lightroom alternative.

apps.name: Typst
apps.pitch: A fast, modern typesetting system: LaTeX-quality documents from simple markup.
apps.why: Great for reports and papers; compiles instantly. CLI install; editor optional.

apps.name: Slidev
apps.pitch: Presentation slides from Markdown, for developers.
apps.why: Write slides as text, present in the browser.
apps.notes: Needs Node.js; the guide shows the one-line setup.

apps.name: Marp
apps.pitch: Markdown presentations with a live preview in VS Code or a CLI.
apps.why: The simplest way to turn notes into slides.

apps.name: Excalidraw
apps.pitch: Hand-drawn style whiteboard and diagrams.
apps.why: Instant sketches and diagrams, nothing to install.

apps.name: Obsidian
apps.pitch: Private, local Markdown notes with links and plugins.
apps.why: Your notes stay plain files; Lens clipper templates save straight into a vault.

apps.name: Logseq
apps.pitch: Outliner and knowledge graph, local-first.
apps.why: Daily notes and linked thinking, open source.

apps.name: Joplin
apps.pitch: Notes and to-dos with end-to-end encrypted sync.
apps.why: Evernote-style, open source, encrypted.

apps.name: Zed
apps.pitch: A very fast code editor, written in Rust, with built-in AI.
apps.why: Snappy, collaborative, open source.

apps.name: VSCodium
apps.pitch: VS Code built from source without Microsoft telemetry.
apps.why: The familiar editor, fully open.

apps.name: VLC
apps.pitch: Plays nearly every audio and video format.
apps.why: The player that just works.

apps.name: HandBrake
apps.pitch: Convert and compress video.
apps.why: Shrink big recordings without losing quality.

apps.name: PowerToys
apps.pitch: Microsoft's power-user utilities: FancyZones, Text Extractor, Color Picker and more.
apps.why: Free, official and open source; pairs well with Lens.

apps.name: Everything
apps.pitch: Finds any file by name instantly.
apps.why: The fastest file-name search on Windows.

apps.name: ShareX
apps.pitch: Screenshots, screen recording and upload workflows.
apps.why: Deep capture automation; Lens Snip covers the everyday cases.

apps.name: Flow Launcher
apps.pitch: Keyboard launcher with a big plugin store.
apps.why: If you want an extra launcher beside Lens Command.

apps.name: 7-Zip
apps.pitch: Open and make zip, 7z, rar and more.
apps.why: Small, fast, free.

apps.name: Ollama
apps.pitch: Run open models (Llama, Qwen, Gemma and more) locally.
apps.why: Lens AI's recommended local model engine.

apps.name: ComfyUI

apps.why: The most flexible local generative pipeline; desktop app available.

apps.name: whisper.cpp
apps.pitch: Fast local speech-to-text.
apps.why: Powers Lens voice and transcription; Lens's Transcription setup handles it for you.
apps.notes: Lens Settings › AI & Command › Transcription sets it up with a pinned, checksum-verified download.
